result:
Round 32 verification is a **PASS**: all six acceptance checks (R32-1 to R32-6) passed, I found no new bugs, and the real-app check ran (`realVerified=true`). The source tree was the same at the end of my phase as at the start; I changed nothing in it.

- **R32-1 (scope):** only the 8 permitted paths changed, and the source change is exactly the D-39 fix. No toast text changed and the frozen files are byte-identical. I can't tell whether A wrote repository files from Bash, because I don't have A's transcript; that is "unknown", not a FAIL.
- **R32-2 (tests fail before, pass after):** with the old `MetadataPanel.tsx` and `App.tsx` in a throwaway copy, 260 tests passed and 8 failed, namely (v1)–(v4) and (v6)–(v9). Each one fails on the actual bug, not on setup. On A's tree all 268 pass, and each of the 11 new tests passes on its own.
- **R32-3 (mutants):** SM-1 to SM-8 were each killed by the expected tests. SM-9 survived, as the task predicted, and it is equivalent: moving the guard after the wait loop still skips the scan. The only difference is up to 5 s of unseen polling.
- **R32-4 (gate):** the full verify command exited 0 from a clean state. Biome reported 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 31, type checks reported 0 errors, and the counts were renderer 268, main 93/93 and end-to-end 7/7. Re-running end-to-end with no retries also gave 7/7.
- **R32-5 (real app, old vs new build):** I drove both builds through the UI under xvfb, with delays and failures injected into the old folder's reads.

  | Scenario | Old build (7355d78) | New build (A's tree) |
  |---|---|---|
  | V (save re-read lands after switching folders) | `s.wav` shows `Tagged` with Category `R32Slow2`, although its read failed | `s.wav` not `Tagged`, Category empty |
  | SC (schema re-read lands after switching folders) | `f.wav` loses `Tagged` and its Category | `f.wav` keeps `Tagged` and `R32Fast`, no toast |
  | SJ (same, re-read fails) | stale `Failed to read 1 files` toast, `f.wav` loses `Tagged` | `f.wav` keeps `Tagged` and `R32Fast`, no toast |

  In all 6 runs the file hashes behaved as expected. ffprobe and music-metadata both read the right Category from each file. `R32note` was never written, and there were no page errors.
- **R32-6 (docs):** every `MetadataPanel.tsx` and `App.tsx` line reference in the bug doc points at the right code. Entries 1–13 only had line numbers shifted, and the README row and the `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md` line are exact.

Points for B (none of these change the PASS):
- **A-R32-01 is a real gap in the schema fix, but I only inferred it from the code.** I did not reproduce it in the app or a test. Steps: open folder A and the field editor, add a field, start opening folder B, then click Done before B's file list arrives. A's files would then overwrite B's tags in the editor. The task excludes only the reverse order, so this case is not covered. It is a candidate for round 33, with A's proposed test (v10).
- **A-R32-02** (a save-related flag can be left set when the file is no longer listed) was not reproduced.
- **Possible flaky test:** when I ran the renderer suite at the same time as another one, test (s1) timed out once. It passed on its own and in the gate. (s1) and (v9) depend on timing, so they may fail occasionally on slow CI.
- **Already known, seen on both builds:** "Unsaved changes were discarded" appears when you open another folder during a save, although the save completes (C-R28-01).
- **Only covered by unit tests:** Close Folder during a save or schema re-read, a drop while the field list is loading, and the parent-folder case. I did not check these in the real app.
- **Windows packaging** is BLOCKED because it is not available in the cloud; it was not part of this round.

The Category values in the reports come from reading the input field. In the screenshots that field is below the fold, so only the `Tagged` badge is visible there.
